data.text:
Severe Tropical Storm Fung-Wong (international name), which will be named Uwan once it enters the Philippine Area of Responsibility, continues to intensify and may reach super typhoon category.

Here are the ways you can secure your livelihood ahead of its impacts:

1. Ensure the safety of your family by staying in safe places identified by the government and far from the possible impact of landslide, flooding, and storm surge. Follow government adivsories.
2. For fishermen, do not head out to sea anymore. Keep your boats and fishing tools and equipment in a safe place far from the possible impact of landslide, flooding, and storm surge. If you
 are managing fisheries, harvest fish ready for consumption.  Place fish nets around fisheries to keep the remaining fingerlings safe.
3. Harvest fruits from your plants and crops including corn, rice, vegetables, and others which may already be suitable for consumption to avoid damage.
4. Place your harvested produce in a safe space to avoid contamination. Place seeds in a dry container to keep them safe from water and excessive moisture.
5. Evacuate farm animals to a high place, far from the possible impact of landslide, flooding, and storm surge. Ensure sufficient food and clean water for farm animals.

#Bagyo #UwanPH #supertyphoon #FungWong
